cards.label: The City
cards.text: A man in a good coat stands very still outside a bank that isn't a bank, watching nothing in particular with the specific attention of someone paid to watch nothing in particular. He doesn't look at you. That's how you know he's looked at you.

By the time you think to look back properly, he's gone, and the space he was standing in has already been filled by three tourists and a Deliveroo rider, as if London itself hurried to paper over the gap.
You add it to a growing list of things about the City you're choosing not to think about too hard.
